name: Quantum spectral flow
plain: Euler/ancestral on x0 passed through frequency gating and momentum, a noise "resonance" step, plus optional Langevin correction with an extra call.
math: x0_p=spectral_guided_blend(x0); momentum blend. d=(x−x0_p)/σ. Ancestral if η>0. stochastic_resonance(x). Correction: x−=step·d_c; x+=√(2·step)·n.
label: from code
surprise: No quantum mechanics in the code; quantum refers to a spectral blend plus momentum.
